P01.rationale: There is no founder or person portrait anywhere on the page; the layout is entirely text-based.

P05.rationale: The client section (Hanisch & Klein) shows only a name and title in text with no portrait image at any size.

P07.rationale: There is no press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus beyond a single pull-quote attribution.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears before the testimonial block, but it is the only decorative typographic element and is modest in scale.

P11.rationale: Three before/after outcome statements are listed in the right column (fragmented→unified, 100% automated, scalable without headcount) but they are presented as text labels rather than true data visualisations or charts.

P12.rationale: The left column is reasonably text-dense but the right column has large empty white gaps between sections, making the overall sheet feel under-filled and not magazine-quality.

P13.rationale: The background is entirely flat white with no texture, atmosphere, or tonal treatment applied.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable and scores absent.

P16.rationale: No device, product mockup, phone, laptop, or book is shown anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: There are no photos at all, so stock imagery is not an issue, but the complete absence of specific visuals makes the page feel generic by default.

N08.rationale: The right column has two large empty white regions—one above the outcome metrics and one between the metrics and the pull-quote—creating noticeable dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo; all text sits on clean white backgrounds with no scrim issues.
